title: Purification after Childbirth
overview: Coherent logical unit: gender-based impurity durations followed by unified purification ritual. Ta'amim hierarchy creates consistent condition → consequence → transition structure.
provenance: Web Grok recovery paste (2026-07-10). Representation only — not autonomous law generation.

taamim_tree_summary.intro: v1 - God spoke to Moses saying (setup)

male_block.condition: Woman conceives and bears male (strong disjunctive pivot)
male_block.restrictions: No touching holy things or entering sanctuary

ritual_block.condition: End of purification period (male or female)
ritual_block.offerings: Burnt offering + sin offering (lamb + bird, or two birds if poor)

derived_logic.pattern: Consistent across chapter: Condition (birth + gender) → Timed states (impurity + purification) → Restrictions/Reference → Transition ritual → New status

variables.restrictions: No holy things / sanctuary during impurity
variables.offering_type: Lamb + bird (or two birds if poor)

derived_logic.consistency: High. Gender difference handled by doubling. Final ritual unifies both cases. Ta'amim verse splits align with logical boundaries.

oral_layer.talmud: Niddah 31a - Explains doubled periods for girls (mother's potential oath during labor pain)
oral_layer.mishnah: Primarily Tractate Niddah (e.g. 3:7 on miscarriage timing and edge cases; 5:3 on caesarean). Focuses on practical counting and status without always quoting Lev 12 directly.

justification: All structure and logic derived from ta'amim hierarchical divisions (LREC treebank methodology) and explicit Written text. Oral sources cited by name. No unsupported inference.
